title: Charts is not implemented
body:
`GET /charts/sales` — list of sales rows, each serialized with exactly the keys `{"id", "category", "month", "amount"}`.

`GET /charts/sales/by-category` — aggregation rows with keys `{"category", "total"}`.

`GET /charts/sales/by-month` — aggregation rows with keys `{"month", "total"}`.

All `/api/v1/charts/*` endpoints are protected routes. Requests without a valid bearer token must return HTTP 401 with `{"error":"unauthorized","detail":"..."}`.
acceptance_hint: 4 executable checks over the charts surface.
